answer: Entry is priced super-linear per funding root: the first key posts 200 POA bond in escrow for 6 epochs, the tenth pays ten times, the hundredth one hundred times, so a basalt wall of clones funds its own blockade. Each key must burn a separate sequential proof where every epoch receipt depends on the prior receipt, verified by peers over a 12-epoch horizon. A raven challenge of 100 POA lets any voter contest a suspected kin cluster, and proven kinship burns the whole ladder. A lotus tally caps each root at one of four quorum votes, so cloning buys tolls while honest keys keep full weight.
